cases.question: What's moving in the semiconductor space this week? Give me the biggest winners and losers by news attention.

tool_calls._note: gics for semis known as 4530; used directly

cases.result_summary: 25 semi names, 7d window, direction_split net_positive 18 / net_negative 6. Winners: NVDA (137 stories, OpenAI Ohio $150-200B), SK Hynix ($28.6B buyback), MRVL, MU, TSMC. Losers/contested: AVGO (net neg), INTC ($20B dilutive offering, UBS cut), Wolfspeed (loss), National Silicon (net loss). Each row carries top_reason + aspects + pos/neg counts.
cases.reason: 7d-scoped, explicit winners-vs-losers split grounded in dated real news reasons.

cases.question: Why is Nvidia down today? What's the news catalyst?
cases.result_summary: 15 dated NVDA items. Net-negative catalysts available: hedge funds cut NVDA exposure (Goldman, Aug23), Amazon custom-chip competition undercuts GPUs (neg), Rubin Ultra HBM cut on memory shortage (neg). Also many pos/neutral (Poolside $6B deal, Citi/Jefferies raise, Q2 earnings Aug26 anticipation). Mixed but concrete + dated.
cases.reason: Returns concrete dated items incl real negative catalysts; not empty, not fabricated. Sentiment/impact drawn from news.

defects.desc: Tool is news-only: has no price/return field to confirm the stock is actually 'down today', so the 'why down' framing rests on negative-impact items rather than a verified price move. Client must not assert direction of the price from news alone.

cases.question: What's the current sentiment on Tesla based on recent news? Bullish or bearish lately?
cases.result_summary: 12 dated TSLA items, clearly MIXED. Bullish: Cybercab scaling (JPMorgan), robotaxi permits Las Vegas/Austin, Einride 500-Semi order, FSD/Optimus. Bearish: China recall ~3M vehicles, $243M Autopilot-crash-data lawsuit. Net leans positive but conflicting.
cases.reason: Sentiment backed by specific dated items, window noted, mixed nature surfaced.

cases.question: Where is options positioning most extreme right now — names with stretched put/call or crowded positioning?
cases.result_summary: positioning_extremes returns 15 real 3y-percentile COT/futures extremes (EURUSD pctl 2, KC wheat 99, SOFR, UST-2Y 100, copper 99, cotton, AUD) framed vs 3y range. options_sentiment with no ticker → error asking for ticker/tickers: there is NO market-wide scan for stretched equity put/call across NAMES.
cases.reason: COT extremes are real, current, and framed vs a 3y norm — but the user asked specifically about equity-options put/call across NAMES, which no tool can scan (options_sentiment needs an explicit ticker).

defects.desc: options_sentiment has no market-wide 'which names have extreme put/call right now' scan mode — it requires the caller to already name the tickers. positioning_extremes only covers futures/COT (fx/commodity/rates/equity_index), not single-name equity options. The 'stretched put/call across names' ask is unanswerable with current tools.

cases.question: In the EV theme, which names got the most news attention over the last two weeks, and was that attention positive or negative?
cases.result_summary: 14d, tier-1 'Electrification & Mobility' node (16000000). 15 names ranked by attention with per-name sentiment: TSLA 51 (pos), GM 15 (mixed, exits battery JV $6B charge), BYD 14 (mixed), EA 13 (pos), VW 7 (mixed), Ford 7, Toyota 7 (neg, margin cut), LGES/Samsung SDI (pos), Xpeng (neg). High attention not conflated with positive.
cases.reason: 14d honored, ranked by attention, each name paired with grounded sentiment.

defects.desc: find_megatrend('electric vehicles') resolved ONLY to a narrow tier-2 'Commercial & Heavy-Duty EV' node (buses/trucks, ~7 names, no Tesla) — the broad theme required guessing the alias 'EV' to reach the tier-1 'Electrification & Mobility'. A dumb client taking the first candidate would badly under-scope the EV theme.

cases.question: Between AMD, Intel and Micron — who had the better week on news? Rank them by impact.
cases.result_summary: All three covered, 7d, dated. MU net-positive (memory-price tailwind, $10B Boise lab; minor neg CEO share sale). AMD contested (record sales + $10B Taiwan invest, but lost SpaceX deal to Nvidia + Google-Marvell hit). INTC net-negative ($20B dilutive equity raise, -6.58%, plummeted on Google-Marvell deal). Enables MU > AMD > INTC ranking.
cases.reason: All three named tickers, 1wk, concrete per-name news supports a relative head-to-head ranking.

defects.desc: Requires one stock_impact call per ticker; no batch/compare form for stock_impact (options_sentiment and stock_prices have batch modes, stock_impact does not), so a head-to-head is 3 round-trips.
